verses.gurmukhi: ਅਖੀ ਵੇਖਿ ਨ ਰਜੀਆ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਤਮਾਸੇ।
verses.translit_en: akhee vekh na rajeeaa bahu ra(n)g tamaase|

en.bdb: The eyes are not satisfied with beholding sights and exhibitions;

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕੰਨਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਰੋਵਣਿ ਤੈ ਹਾਸੇ।
verses.translit_en: ausatat ni(n)dhaa ka(n)n sun rovan tai haase|

en.bdb: The ears are not satisfied with hearing praise or blame, mourning or rejoicing;

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਦੀਂ ਜੀਭ ਨ ਰਜੀਆ ਕਰਿ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਲਾਸੇ।
verses.translit_en: saadhee(n) jeebh na rajeeaa kar bhog bilaase|

en.bdb: The tongue is not satisfied with eating what affords pleasure and delight;

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਕ ਨ ਰਜਾ ਵਾਸੁ ਲੈ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਸੁਵਾਸੇ।
verses.translit_en: nak na rajaa vaas lai dhuraga(n)dh suvaase|

en.bdb: The nose is not contented with good or evil odour;

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਜਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਕੂੜੇ ਭਰਵਾਸੇ।
verses.translit_en: raj na koiee jeeviaa kooRe bharavaase|

en.bdb: Nobody is satisfied with his span of life, and everyone entertains false hopes.
But the Sikhs are satisfied with the Guru and theirs is the true love and delight.
